note: Marion County, AR publishes no queryable zoning districts. Arkansas counties have limited zoning authority and the county site links no zoning or GIS layer; the County Clerk holds zoning maps on paper. The only municipal zoning found, City of Flippin, is a PDF map (overall city zoning map). No ArcGIS/WFS/OGC service found for Yellville, Bull Shoals, Summit or Flippin, and ArcGIS search and the Arkansas GIS Office services (gis.arkansas.gov FEATURESERVICES) have no zoning layer.
